data.heading: A small office, close to the work
data.body: Northline is a neighborhood practice for everyday professional work: planning, paperwork, and the follow-through that usually slips. We keep the site and the office the same: short sentences, visible hours, and no surprise steps. This is sample copy for a reusable starter site, not a live business listing.
